newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares tiptoe up but investors stay away.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares tiptoe up but investors stay away.

text.p: Norwegian shares tiptoed upwards on Monday in thin trade as investors bided time before year end.
"We're up a bit today but it's really very quiet. Nobody's willing to do much. It's been a good year up to now so why spoil things in the last week," said one Oslo-based dealer.
Oslo's Total share index put on 0.5 percent to 933.20 points in a moderate 574 million crowns of business.
Industrial giant Nork Hydro was the most traded share in value terms and gained two crowns to close at 258.50 crowns in just over 80 million crowns of trade.
